header.cleanBody: If you control Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue Spirits, one of each, both players return all their cards to their decks and shuffle, and send all cores other than those in Life to the Void. Then, both players put six cores from the Void to their Reserve, draw two cards, play rock-paper-scissor to determine the playing order, and the game restarts from Turn 1. This effect can only be used by either you or the opponent once per game.
